# ex: drop explicit * in selector when selector adds implicit * (ex.go:629-632)
# When replx is *ptr (StarExpr) and it's substituted into a selector position,
# the selector can add the implicit *, so the explicit * is dropped.
ex {
	var x T
	F(x) -> x.Take()
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T int

func (t T) Take() T { return t }
func F(T)           {}

func _() {
	var ptr *T
	F(*ptr)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -7,5 +7,5 @@

 func _() {
 	var ptr *T
-	F(*ptr)
+	ptr.Take()
 }
